name: ai-talk
description: AI Talk is a risk-tiered development gate with a zero-contract Fast Path and evidence-backed RequirementContract 1.3 handoffs for complex work.

interface.shortDescription: Compile development requests with optional strict mode
interface.longDescription: AI Talk automatically matches development work without requiring a command prefix. Clear, reversible, local changes with resolved targets use a no-contract Fast Path with no reference reads or feedback reporter calls. Unresolved visual references, quoted, cross-module, scope-bounded, diagnostic, and ambiguous work uses RequirementContract 1.3 with progressive evidence loading. Repository strict mode installs a managed AGENTS.md rule so every development message runs the gate once.
capabilities: Transparent pass-through for status and confirmation messages
No-contract Fast Path for clear local work
Zero reference and reporter calls on Fast Path
Progressive protocol loading for complex work
Explicit excluded scope and bounded write policy
Stable selector and DOM fingerprint capture
Entry point and control point separation
Live browser evidence for UI failures
DOM, geometry, occlusion, and resource inspection
